repairs.rule: Equality producer original-main source-freeze has exact metadata status DEVELOPMENT_ONLY and root003_reusable false plus exact candidate_sha256/test_sha256 keys. Require exact four-key set; freeze_map original-main exact two source keys; metadata authenticated as metadata, only two mapped sources compared to actual whole frozen hashes. For original-additional/private-binding require exact equality between observed source-freeze keys and preregistered source map keys, every value exact source SHA, no metadata/hash confusion or undeclared extra fields.

Fresh refs outside current qualification root but under explicitly registered own freshfixture prefix must also be exact frozen source_hashes members with actual retained bytes SHA equal. Fresh dynamic evidence stays under new qualification root. This aligns Reader with already registered AdditionalPredicates and assembler admission without expanding eligible paths.

Suite actual invocation.driver_sha256 must bind configured current gate_driver source, and suite external_bindings_before/after must have exact current configured gate_driver plus three whole-root metadata files, authenticating all current bytes. Preserve exact tests/counts/outcomes/phase0/model0 and unchanged source guards.
